expectations.text: Uses `git-stack --push` (a flag on the top-level command), not a `git-stack push` subcommand
Explains only the root/bottom branch (feature-a) is 'ready'; branches stacked on other dev branches are held back
expectations.evidence: Table and prose: only feature-a is ready (root on main); feature-b/c held back because stacked on a dev branch; notes even rewording WIP wouldn't make feature-b push while stacked above feature-a.

expectations.text: Identifies the 'WIP:' commit on feature-b as a blocker and suggests rewording/finishing it
expectations.evidence: Lists WIP as reason (a) for feature-b; 'To clear feature-b's WIP ... finish the work or reword the commit ... git-stack reword ...'.

expectations.text: Recommends one-PR-at-a-time strategy and/or setting each gh PR base to the branch below it (not all onto main)
expectations.evidence: Recommends landing one at a time; alternative shows gh pr create --base feature-a/feature-b for stacked PRs.

summary: All four satisfied with the correct ready-branch model, WIP blocker, and stacked-PR base strategy.
